name: harness-write
title: Harness Writing
description: [upsert|slots] Draft and update writing for people: evidence-grounded feature docs, onboarding, and troubleshooting guides; stakeholder trackers, meeting invites, and email updates or thread replies; and dashboards, reports, and queries; rank meeting slots offline. Shorthand: /hn-write; upsert takes doc|tracker|meeting|email|report. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on rationale, harness-monitor on status and owner evidence, harness-work on report implementation, kpi-dashboard and jarvis-metrics on report design, and the office-documents and ppt-master references on document output. Drafts only: never sends, invites, shares, or publishes without explicit approval.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Omitted means read-only listing. Create and update are aliases for upsert.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: What upsert creates or updates; required unless clear from the conversation.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Feature or doc set, initiative, email purpose, or report artifact; required for upsert unless clear from the conversation.

inputs.name: audience
inputs.description: Doc audience. Reuse the established audience or clarify it. Partner access does not imply public disclosure.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Report platform. Infer only from an unambiguous request or existing artifact; otherwise ask.

inputs.name: thread
inputs.description: Exact subject of an existing mail thread: the reply-all target for email, and an attendee source for slots or meeting.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Explicit destination for a doc set or report. Otherwise reuse the coding repository's documentation convention, then docs/guides/<feature> when no convention exists.
